meters.ai_confidence: 2^(-ensemble spread / B1 alarm threshold): 50% at B1's alarm line
meters.referee_score: 1 - 2^(-referee score / referee alarm threshold): 50% at its alarm line

scenarios.title: Normal swing
scenarios.selection_rule: median peak referee score among 136 cal runs (gentle, clean); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Big swing
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 16 cal runs (large, clean); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Longer string
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 20 cal runs (gentle, length, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Broken sensor
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 5 cal runs (gentle, stuck, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Drifting sensor
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 4 cal runs (gentle, drift, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Hidden magnet
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 15 cal runs (gentle, magnet, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Sudden kick
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 11 cal runs (gentle, impulse, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Dropout (missed)
scenarios.selection_rule: median onset among 19 faulty cal runs the referee never flagged
